body:
Owner-requested GitHub issue https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/503; parallel execution requested 2026-10-03.

## Problem (semantics unclear, verified on main-32aa5a3)
After claim timeouts consumed all six retries, `ticket show` reported `retries: charged 6, remaining 0, exhausted: false`, status `OPEN`, and `plan preview` showed the ticket SELECTED. `ticket reopen --role OWNER --expected-revision 6` was REFUSED with `TICKET_STATE`. Two agents read `remaining=0` as exhausted, refused to claim, and waited for an owner reopen that can never succeed, which cost two full review sessions on the critical-path ticket.

## Expected
One unambiguous state. Either `remaining=0` means exhausted (status RETRY_EXHAUSTED, reopen allowed, not SELECTED), or the field is not shown as 0 while the ticket is still claimable. `ticket show` should include a `claimable: true|false` plus the reason, and the reopen refusal should say which condition failed.

Related: #494 (a claim that never produced an attempt should not be charged), #427, #378.
